stem: Which sentence from paragraph 1 of the article “The Broken-Crayon Solution” describes in a similar way what led to building an invention?
instruction:
Read this sentence from paragraph 3 of the selection “Bouncing Around.”  

So, in his garage, Nissen tied heavy canvas to a steel frame.

options.label: F
options.text: One day 11-year-old Cassidy Goldstein was trying to work on an art project.

options.label: G
options.text: She noticed that all of her crayons were broken.

options.label: H
options.text: Then Cassidy found some plastic tubes used to hold single-cut flowers.

options.label: J
options.text: She would make her own crayon holders.

visual_elements: So, in his garage, Nissen tied heavy canvas to a steel frame.
